acceptanceCriteria: Spec bodies and page-object methods normalise into one closed step IR (visit, click, fill, select, check, upload, wait-for, assert with matcher/value) carrying locator, parameter slots and source span, for Playwright, Cypress and Capybara at least.
Page-object calls inline to their IR with arguments bound; unparseable steps become explicit opaque steps, never dropped.
Identical step sequences across tests deduplicate into reusable step records with usage counts.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. DCP-V1-061..063 extract assertions and setup calls only; there is no cross-framework action IR or parameterised reusable step.
title: Site knowledge 2: normalised step IR (visit/click/fill/select/assert with locator and parameter) from spec bodies and page-object methods
